mongo_query: [{"$project": {"matGUID": 1, "Material Name": 1, "Categories": 1, "Material Notes": 1, "Electrical Resistance": {"$max": {"$map": {"input": "$parsed_properties.Electrical Properties.Electrical Resistivity.units", "as": "item", "in": "$$item.max"}}}}}, {"$sort": {"Electrical Resistance": -1}}, {"$limit": 3}]

user_query: What are the strongest ceramic materials
mongo_query: [{"$match": {"Categories": {"$in": ["Ceramic"]}}}, {"$project": {"matGUID": 1, "Material Name": 1, "Categories": 1, "Material Notes": 1, "Compressive Strength": {"$max": {"$map": { "input": "$parsed_properties.Mechanical Properties.Compressive Strength.units", "as": "item", "in": "$$item.max" }}}}}, {"$sort": {"Compressive Strength": -1}}]

user_query: What are the weakest ceramic materials?
mongo_query: [{"$match": {"Categories": {"$in": ["Ceramic"]}}}, {"$project": {"matGUID": 1, "Material Name": 1, "Categories": 1, "Material Notes": 1, "Compressive Strength": {"$min": {"$map": {"input": {"$filter": {"input": "$parsed_properties.Mechanical Properties.Compressive Strength.units", "as": "item", "cond": {"$ne": ["$$item.min", null]}}}, "as": "item", "in": "$$item.min"}}}}}, {"$sort": {"Compressive Strength": 1}}]

user_query: What are the Ceramic materials with max service temp above 1600°C
mongo_query: [{"$match": {"Categories": {"$in": ["Ceramic"]}}}, {"$project": {"matGUID": 1, "Material Name": 1, "Categories": 1, "Material Notes": 1, "Max Service Temp": {"$max": {"$map": { "input": "$parsed_properties.Thermal Properties.Maximum Service Temperature, Air.units", "as": "item", "in": "$$item.max" }}}}}, {"$match": {"Max Service Temp": {"$gt": 1600}}}]

user_query: Find materials with Flexural Modulus between 100 and 500 GPa
mongo_query: [{"$match": {"parsed_properties.Mechanical Properties.Flexural Modulus.units": {"$elemMatch": {"unit": "GPa", "$or": [{"$and": [{"min": {"$ne": null}}, {"min": {"$gte": 100}}, {"min": {"$lte": 500}}]}, {"$and": [{"max": {"$ne": null}}, {"max": {"$gte": 100}}, {"max": {"$lte": 500}}]}, {"$and": [{"min": {"$ne": null}}, {"max": {"$ne": null}}, {"min": {"$lte": 100}}, {"max": {"$gte": 500}}]}]}}}}, {"$project": {"matGUID": 1, "Material Name": 1, "Categories": 1, "Material Notes": 1, "Flexural Modulus (GPa)": {"$filter": {"input": "$parsed_properties.Mechanical Properties.Flexural Modulus.units", "as": "fm", "cond": {"$and": [ {"$eq": ["$$fm.unit", "GPa"]}, {"$or": [ {"$and": [ {"$ne": ["$$fm.min", null]}, {"$gte": ["$$fm.min", 100]}, {"$lte": ["$$fm.min", 500]} ]}, {"$and": [ {"$ne": ["$$fm.max", null]}, {"$gte": ["$$fm.max", 100]}, {"$lte": ["$$fm.max", 500]} ]}, {"$and": [ {"$ne": ["$$fm.min", null]}, {"$ne": ["$$fm.max", null]}, {"$lte": ["$$fm.min", 100]}, {"$gte": ["$$fm.max", 500]} ]} ]} ]}}}}, {"$sort": {"Flexural Modulus (GPa).min": 1}}]
